subject: Lodestar: tailoring draws on the full grounded pool (Option B)
description: Per-application tailoring should project the full enriched pool (profile north_star + matched-track keywords/titles + vetted skills) as EMPHASIS/FRAMING, while the résumé stays the ONLY source of factual claims. Option B: add a "TARGET POSITIONING (framing only)" block to tailor.build_user_prompt + a _SYSTEM clause + a NEW pure foreground_terms(terms, resume, posting) that yields only terms grounded in the résumé AND named in the posting (grounded-by-construction; a job-wanted-but-résumé-absent skill is never foregrounded). Thread positioning through tailor.tailor + the dashboard tailor endpoint (loads profile via scorer.load_profile, matched track via rationale['matched_track']). Existing tailor.unverified_terms output tripwire stays as backstop. Nancy design review in flight -> build -> Nancy as-built -> Chris -> commit. test_tailor.py extended.
